subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should maintainers accept source-level positive/negative tests plus redacted pre-fix production logs as enough proof for this xAI/Grok provider-side rotation bug, or require organic after-fix Grok/gateway evidence before merge?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot mark external PR real-behavior proof sufficient without after-fix real output, but the reported trigger appears provider-owned and not safely inducible on demand.

options.title: Apply proof override after review
options.body: Accept the non-inducible trigger explanation, require exact-head CI/rebase freshness, and merge if normal maintainer review agrees the narrow predicate is safe.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a real xAI/Grok rotation event produces redacted logs showing the stripped retry succeeds after this patch.

options.title: Replace with maintainer-owned fix
options.body: Close or supersede this branch only if maintainers want to carry the same narrow predicate/test change themselves with their own proof policy.

recommendation.title: Apply proof override after review
recommendation.body: Accept the non-inducible trigger explanation, require exact-head CI/rebase freshness, and merge if normal maintainer review agrees the narrow predicate is safe.
